finalLens.title: When Proof Fits
finalLens.intro: After reading the offer twice, you look for the smallest way to try it without giving up your footing.
finalLens.pull_quote: You can feel the pull of something new and still need it to show you where you can stand.
finalLens.deeper_read: With an offer in front of you, you ask what would make it worth leaving the proven position and look for a version you can try first. That is how interest stops circling privately and gains enough shape to be spoken aloud.
